$comment: Waivers for the R-1 client claim limb (src/test/clientClaims.test.ts).
One entry per line-pattern. `literal` is a case-insensitive regular expression
matched against the string literal the scanner found, NOT against the whole line,
so it survives the line moving. Every entry needs a reason a critic can check.
Nothing here waives a rendered economic claim: every entry below is a Module 1
domain noun, a DOM id, a CSS class name, a payload key name, the name of a
surface (the projector), or the product stating that a preview does not exist.
The Module 2 Lesson 1 renderer (renderFullHouse and its helpers) has NO entry
here, and must not acquire one: its economic sentences come from the module.
